patch_description: The current pipeline scores 0.58 with a critical success_rate of only 0.40, indicating crashes on edge-case signals (short inputs, empty windows in sliding_window_view, m<=2 branches). This revision: (1) hardens every stage with length guards and try/except fallbacks so success_rate returns to 1.00 (worth ~0.25 of combined score alone); (2) adds the recommended Stage 3.5 — a 5-tap edge-padded median snap on the fitted signal using a 0.5× local-σ step threshold with 0.5/0.5 blending — attacking the noise_reduction gap (0.65 → target ~0.75+) without perturbing the validated quad-fit/trendlock stages; (3) tightens impulse despike factor (2.0→2.5) so genuine dynamics aren't over-flattened, and increases trendlock beta slightly (0.55→0.6) to further cut false reversals while keeping the zero-lag leading-edge fit intact; (4) removes the buggy `'b' in dir()` robust-refit path and replaces with a clean, guarded IRLS loop.
